ultimas_noticias.titulo: South Korea Aims to Cut Middle East Crude Reliance to 50% by 2035
ultimas_noticias.resumen_es: South Korea will try to cut its reliance on Middle East crude imports to 50% by 2035, Reuters has reported, citing the country’s industry ministry. The ministry has drafted a 10-year natural resource security plan, which envisages a “fundamental shift” in the way South Korea sources its imports. The plan also calls for a boost in oil reserves by some 20 million barrels by 2030. ultimas_noticias.titulo: US Gasoline, Distillate Inventories Continue to Fall as Crude Stocks Hold
ultimas_noticias.resumen_es: The American Petroleum Institute (API) estimated that crude oil inventories in the United States rose by 1.786 million barrels in the week ending September 18. In the week prior, US crude oil inventories grew by a substantial 7.14 million barrels. Commercial crude oil inventories excluding the SPR have lost 39 million barrels over the last 23 weeks, but US crude inventories are up nearly 12 million for the year, according to API data, kept in check by draws from the SPR.
